game.name: Retro Arcade Studio (50 Modernized Classics + WASM + CRT)
game.desc: 50 modernized classic coin-op arcade games with WebAssembly pathfinding, WebGL CRT shaders, procedural Web Audio, and USB/GPIO arcade stick support.

game.name: Lode Runner (1983 Irem / Brøderbund)
game.desc: Dig bricks to trap guards & collect all gold chests to reveal the escape ladder. Enhancements: 8s brick regen, WASM A* guard AI & walking on trapped guards. Controls: 4-Way Move/Climb + Blast Left(Z/Q) + Blast Right(X/E)

game.name: Dig Dug (1982 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Carve dirt tunnels, inflate Pookas & Fygars with your air pump & drop boulders. Enhancements: 4-color soil strata, 4-stage monster inflation & rock crushes. Controls: 4-Way Tunneling + Pump Harpoon (Z/Space)

game.name: Donkey Kong (1981 Nintendo Coin-Op)
game.desc: Climb slanted steel girders, jump rolling barrels & grab hammers across 8 stages. Enhancements: 25m Girders, 50m Conveyor, 75m Elevators & 100m Rivet Tower. Controls: Left/Right + Up/Down Ladders + Jump (Z/Space)

game.name: Sumo Arcade (1984 Technōs / Data East)
game.desc: Push, slap-stun & sidestep your rival sumo wrestler out of the circular Dohyo ring. Enhancements: Stamina friction physics & pulsing ring-edge danger tension. Controls: Move + Power Shove(Z) + Palm Slap/Sidestep(X)

game.name: Pac-Man / Ms. Pac (1980 Namco / Midway)
game.desc: Eat all maze dots & power pellets to chomp Blinky, Pinky, Inky & Clyde for 1600 pts. Enhancements: 4 distinct arcade mazes, 4 ghost AI personalities & bonus fruit. Controls: 4-Way D-Pad/Swipe + Toggle Ms. Pac-Man (X)

game.name: Frogger (1981 Konami / Sega)
game.desc: Hop your frog across 5 lanes of speeding cars & ride floating river logs to home bays. Enhancements: Diving turtles, crocodiles, bonus flies & strict 60s life timer. Controls: 4-Way Hop / Tap-to-Leap Direction

game.name: Galaga (1981 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Blast diving alien bug formations & rescue your captured fighter for Dual-Ship guns. Enhancements: Boss tractor-beam capture/rescue & 4-shot Dual Fighter mode. Controls: Left/Right Dodge + Fire Twin Lasers (Z/Space)

game.name: Space Invaders (1978 Taito Coin-Op)
game.desc: Defend Earth behind 4 destructible bunkers against 55 marching alien invaders & UFOs. Enhancements: Accelerating fleet march heartbeat & pixel-eroded shields. Controls: Left/Right Cannon + Fire Laser (Z/Space)

game.name: Asteroids (1979 Atari Vector)
game.desc: Rotate & thrust your vector ship to shatter splitting boulders & UFO saucers. Enhancements: Glowing vector lines, wrap-around physics & 3-stage rock splits. Controls: Rotate + Thrust(Up) + Fire(Z) + Hyperspace(X)

game.name: Centipede (1980 Atari Coin-Op)
game.desc: Shoot the winding multi-segment centipede & spiders through a mushroom field. Enhancements: Splitting centipede chains, 4-hit mushrooms, Fleas & Scorpions. Controls: 4-Way Bottom Zone + Rapid Blaster (Z)

game.name: Defender (1981 Williams Coin-Op)
game.desc: Fly across a wrap-around alien planet with radar scanner to save humanoids. Enhancements: Live top radar minimap, mid-air human catches & Mutant AI. Controls: Thrust/Move + Laser(Z) + Smart Bomb(X)

game.name: Arkanoid (1986 Taito Coin-Op)
game.desc: Bounce the energy ball off your Vaus paddle to smash 12 brick fortresses & capsules. Enhancements: [E] Expand, [M] 3-Ball Multiball, [L] Dual Lasers & [S] Slow. Controls: Left/Right Paddle + Launch/Fire Laser (Z)

game.name: Paperboy (1985 Atari System 2)
game.desc: Steer your bike up the street, toss newspapers into mailboxes & dodge hazards. Enhancements: Subscriber mailboxes, breakable non-subscriber windows & dogs. Controls: Steer/Speed + Throw Newspaper (Z)

game.name: Joust (1982 Williams Coin-Op)
game.desc: Flap your flying ostrich above lava & defeat buzzard riders by striking from higher up. Enhancements: Higher-lance wins, hatching eggs & grasping Lava Troll Hand. Controls: Left/Right + Flap Wings (Z / Up)

game.name: Q*bert (1982 Gottlieb Coin-Op)
game.desc: Hop diagonally across a 3D cube pyramid to flip every tile color while dodging Coily. Enhancements: Coily snake chase AI & floating escape discs on pyramid sides. Controls: 4-Way Diagonal Pyramid Hops

game.name: Rampage (1986 Bally Midway)
game.desc: Climb skyscrapers as a giant monster & punch windows until the buildings collapse. Enhancements: Collapsing multi-story towers, helicopters, tanks & snacks. Controls: Climb/Walk + Punch Building(Z) + Jump(X)

game.name: Marble Madness (1984 Atari System 1)
game.desc: Roll your marble down 10 steep 3D isometric ramp courses before the timer expires. Enhancements: 10 courses with 3D slopes, ice patches, bumpers & speed pads. Controls: 4-Way Roll Acceleration + Turbo Boost (Z)

game.name: Pitfall! (1982 Activision Classic)
game.desc: Swing on vines over tar pits, hop across crocodile jaws & grab jungle treasures. Enhancements: Upper jungle canopy + underground scorpion cavern paths. Controls: Run/Climb Ladders + Jump/Grab Vine (Z)

game.name: Duck Hunt (1984 Nintendo Vs./NES)
game.desc: Click/tap or aim the crosshair to shoot fast-flying ducks with 3 shells per wave. Enhancements: 3-shell shotgun reload, bouncing duck flight & hunting dog. Controls: Click/Tap Duck or Aim Crosshair + Shoot(Z)

game.name: Excitebike (1984 Nintendo Vs. System)
game.desc: Race your dirt bike over huge stunt ramps, pitch mid-air & manage turbo engine heat. Enhancements: Engine overheat gauge, track cooling arrows & rival bikers. Controls: Switch Lane/Pitch + Gas(Z) + Turbo Boost(X)

game.name: Missile Command (1980 Atari Coin-Op)
game.desc: Launch counter-missiles from 3 batteries to detonate incoming warheads above 6 cities. Enhancements: Expanding blast shockwaves that chain-destroy split warheads. Controls: Click/Tap Sky or Aim Crosshair + Fire ABM(Z)

game.name: BurgerTime (1982 Data East Coin-Op)
game.desc: Walk across giant buns, patties & lettuce on kitchen scaffolds to drop burgers onto trays. Enhancements: Cascading burger slices & multi-floor enemy crush bonuses. Controls: 4-Way Scaffold Climb + Throw Pepper Stun(X)

game.name: Bubble Bobble (1986 Taito Coin-Op)
game.desc: Blow bubbles to trap cave monsters, pop them in chains & collect giant bonus fruit. Enhancements: 12 cave layouts, air currents & chain-pop fruit multipliers. Controls: Move + Blow Bubble(Z) + Jump(X / Up)

game.name: Spy Hunter (1983 Bally Midway)
game.desc: Drive the G-6155 Interceptor at high speed, firing machine guns & dropping oil slicks. Enhancements: Dock inside the red Weapons Van for Oil & Smoke upgrades. Controls: Steer/Speed + Machine Gun(Z) + Oil/Smoke(X)

game.name: Tron (1982 Bally Midway)
game.desc: Steer your neon light cycle at 90° angles to trap rival AI cycles behind light walls. Enhancements: Predictive raycast AI cycles & high-speed trail boxing. Controls: 4-Way 90° Turns + Turbo Boost(Z) + Brake(X)

game.name: Track & Field (1983 Konami Coin-Op)
game.desc: Mash sprint buttons to build speed & time your launch angle across 5 Olympic events. Enhancements: 100m Dash, Long Jump, Javelin, 110m Hurdles & High Jump. Controls: Mash Run(Z or L/R) + Jump/Throw Angle(X)

game.name: OutRun (1986 Sega Super Scaler)
game.desc: Drift your red convertible at 290 km/h down branching palm-lined sunset highways. Enhancements: 3D hills & curves, tire smoke drifts & Left/Right road forks. Controls: Steer + Accelerate(Z/Up) + Drift Brake(X/Down)

game.name: Contra (1987 Konami Coin-Op)
game.desc: Run-and-gun across jungle bridges with 8-way aiming & 5-way Spread Shot powerups. Enhancements: Spread Shot [S], Rapid [R], Laser [L] & Fortress Wall Boss. Controls: 8-Way Aim/Move + Shoot(Z) + Jump(X)

game.name: Galaxian (1979 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Shoot convecting alien insect squadrons & Flagships diving in escort formations. Enhancements: Flagship + 2 Red Escort formation dives for 800-pt bonuses. Controls: Left/Right Dodge + Fire Nose Missile (Z)

game.name: Dig Dug II (1985 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Inflate monsters with your pump or hammer fault-line pegs to sink island chunks. Enhancements: Fracture coastal fault lines to drown multiple enemies at once. Controls: 4-Way Walk + Pump(Z) + Jackhammer Fault Peg(X)

game.name: Elevator Action (1983 Taito Coin-Op)
game.desc: Ride elevators down a spy tower, steal secret files behind red doors & shoot agents. Enhancements: Shoot ceiling lamps for blackout cover & crush spies with elevators. Controls: Move/Ride Elevator + Shoot(Z) + Jump Kick(X)

game.name: Tapper (1983 Bally Midway)
game.desc: Slide frosty root beer mugs down 4 saloon bars to thirsty patrons & catch empties. Enhancements: 4 parallel counters, sliding empty glasses & tip bonuses. Controls: Up/Down Switch Bar + Pour/Slide Mug(Z) + Run(L/R)

game.name: Lunar Lander (1979 Atari Vector)
game.desc: Rotate thrusters & feather your rocket burn to land gently on 2X-5X moon pads. Enhancements: Vector telemetry HUD, fuel conservation & 5X narrow crater pads. Controls: Rotate Left/Right + Variable Rocket Thrust (Z/Up)

game.name: Tempest (1981 Atari Color Vector)
game.desc: Spin your yellow claw blaster around 3D neon wireframe tubes to blast Flippers. Enhancements: 12 Atari 3D vector tubes + screen-wiping Superzapper. Controls: Left/Right Rim Spin + Rapid Fire(Z) + Superzapper(X)

game.name: Robotron: 2084 (1982 Williams Coin-Op)
game.desc: Blast relentless robot swarms in 8 directions while rescuing the last human family. Enhancements: Grunts, indestructible Hulks, Spheroids, Brains & 5000-pt rescues. Controls: 8-Way Move & Fire(Z) + Lock Aim Strafe(X)

game.name: Sinistar (1982 Williams Coin-Op)
game.desc: Mine Sinibomb crystals from planetoids before worker drones build the giant skull boss. Enhancements: 13-piece boss construction, radar scanner & Sinibomb homing blasts. Controls: 8-Way Thrust + Laser(Z) + Fire Sinibomb(X)

game.name: Crystal Castles (1983 Atari Coin-Op)
game.desc: Guide Bentley Bear across 3D isometric castle ramps & elevators to scoop up every gem. Enhancements: Magic Hat invincibility, Honey Pots, Gem Eaters & Witch hazard. Controls: 4-Way Isometric Walk + Jump(Z)

game.name: Zaxxon (1982 Sega Coin-Op)
game.desc: Fly diagonally through an isometric space fortress using your altitude gauge & shadow. Enhancements: Live altitude meter, ground shadow targeting, fuel tanks & Zaxxon Boss. Controls: Left/Right Bank + Up/Down Altitude + Laser(Z)

game.name: Moon Patrol (1982 Irem / Williams)
game.desc: Drive a 6-wheel lunar buggy jumping craters while firing forward & upward lasers. Enhancements: Articulated 6-wheel suspension, bomb-dropping UFOs & checkpoints A-Z. Controls: Speed L/R + Dual Cannon/AA Laser(Z) + Jump(X/Up)

game.name: Pengo (1982 Sega Coin-Op)
game.desc: Push sliding ice blocks across a frozen maze to crush Sno-Bees & align 3 diamonds. Enhancements: 10,000-pt 3-Diamond alignment jackpot & electric wall stun. Controls: 4-Way Move + Push/Shatter Ice Block or Stun Wall(Z)

game.name: Rally-X (1980 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Race through scrolling mazes using the radar to grab 10 flags & smoke-spin rival cars. Enhancements: Live right-side radar minimap, Special [S] flag multiplier & fuel gauge. Controls: 4-Way Steer + Deploy Smoke Screen Cloud(Z/X)

game.name: Road Fighter (1984 Konami Coin-Op)
game.desc: Weave through traffic at 400 km/h, counter-steer skids & touch rainbow fuel cars. Enhancements: Narrowing bridges, oil slicks & counter-steer skid recovery physics. Controls: Steer/Counter-Steer + Low Gear(Z) + Turbo Gear(X)

game.name: Flicky (1984 Sega Coin-Op)
game.desc: Lead a trailing chain of rescued yellow Piopio chicks to the exit door while dodging cats. Enhancements: Chain-rescue score multipliers & throwable flowerpots vs Tiger Cats. Controls: Left/Right Run + Jump/Flutter(Z) + Throw Item(X)

game.name: Syndicate (1993 Bullfrog / EA)
game.desc: Command 4 trenchcoat cyber-agents with Miniguns, Gauss Cannons & the mind-control Persuadertron. Enhancements: Persuadertron mind-control, 4-agent tactical squad, Gauss cannons & rainy megacity neon. Controls: Tactical Move/Aim + Fire Arsenal(Z/Space) + IPA Overdrive(X) + Switch Weapon(C)

game.name: Circus Charlie (1984 Konami Coin-Op)
game.desc: Jump a lion through flaming rings, walk tightropes over monkeys & hop circus balls. Enhancements: 5 classic Big Top events: Lion Rings, Tightrope, Balls, Horse & Trapeze. Controls: Left/Right Pace + Stunt Leap(Z/Up)

game.name: Battle City (1985 Namco Classic)
game.desc: Command your golden tank through brick walls to defend the Phoenix base from enemy armor. Enhancements: Destructible brick/steel walls, Star upgrades, Base Shovel & Time Freeze. Controls: 4-Way Tank Tread + Fire Shell(Z)

game.name: Kung-Fu Master (1984 Irem / Data East)
game.desc: Battle across 5 temple floors with jump-kicks & crouch-punches to defeat dojo bosses. Enhancements: Grippers, Knife Throwers, Dragon Pots & 5 Floor Boss showdowns. Controls: Walk/Jump/Crouch + Punch(Z) + Kick(X)

game.name: Wild Gunman (1984 Nintendo Zapper)
game.desc: Wait for the outlaw’s eyes to flash "FIRE!!" then draw & shoot in milliseconds. Enhancements: Millisecond reaction timer, early-draw FOUL detection & Saloon Gang mode. Controls: Click/Tap Outlaw or Press Draw(Z) on "FIRE!!"

game.name: Exerion (1983 Jaleco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Master gliding momentum over 3D alien terrain with Dual Slow & Single Fast cannons. Enhancements: Authentic ship momentum physics & ammo-charging Fast Cannon. Controls: Inertia Steer + Fast Cannon(Z) + Dual Blaster(X)

game.name: Tetris & Columns (1988 Atari / 1990 Sega)
game.desc: Clear 4-line Tetrominoes or match 3-gem jewel chains in a dual-mode puzzle cabinet. Enhancements: 2-in-1 Tetris + Columns modes, ghost piece, combos & neon bursts. Controls: Move/Drop + Rotate/Cycle Gems(Z/Up) + Switch Mode(X)

game.name: Pokemon Kanto Adventure (Custom JS Port)
game.desc: Explore Pallet Town and Route 1 with Pikachu, Charmander, Squirtle, or Bulbasaur, battle wild Pokemon, and catch em all!
